thread:
sasha: Heads-up — found an edge-case in the JSON log pipeline where `gpu_id` can leak host metadata that looks like customer identifiers (vm-owner-<email>). Need a quick rollout to redact and add grouping tags.
linh: Hmm, we saw weird strings in S3 too. Example: `gpu_id`: "vm-owner-alex.j@corp.com-gpu4". That's definitely PII.
omar: Agree, we should treat any `gpu_id` with `@` as PII and scrub. Also think about preserving `gpu_group` (e.g., `a100-8x`) for cost dashboards.
sasha: Proposed change: pipeline adds `gpu_group` derived from instance type or SKU, and replaces `gpu_id` with `gpu_id_hash` (sha256 first 8 chars) unless `redact_pii=false` for dedicated accounts. Patch diff I have:```json
{"gpu_id":"vm-owner-alex.j@corp.com-gpu4","gpu_group":null}
```
-> becomes ->
```json
{"gpu_id_hash":"e3b0c442","gpu_group":"a100-8x"}
```
jen: Can we avoid hashing for on-prem/private customers? They want full ids for inventory. We should gate by tenant type.
matt: +1. Gate by `tenant_profile` in the routing metadata. If `tenant_profile==private` keep full `gpu_id`, else hash and drop anything matching email regex.
linh: Sampling note: we currently have 1% JSON sampling on prod to cut costs. If we change schema we need to ensure sampled messages still include enough `gpu_group` variety. Suggest we bias sampling by region and instance family: `us-west-2:2%`, `eu-central:1%`, `a100-family:5%` to surface regressions.
sasha: Good call. Also need to update Grafana dashboards and alerts to use `gpu_group` as a label. Existing SLO dashboard queries assume `gpu_type` metric; add logs-based panel mapping: `label_replace(json_gpu_group, ...)` or use existing metrics exporter to emit `gpu_group` metric.
omar: For alert tuning — current Alert: `high_gpu_errors` fires on 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m. With extra fields we can create `gpu_error_by_group` and only alert when a single `gpu_group` has >1% and > 100 errors to reduce noise.
jen: Who's owning the canary? I can run the rollout in us-west for 2 hours, watch ingest rates and SLOs. Need the playbook: rollback script, small reingest flag, and metrics to watch.
sasha: Canary plan: deploy parser change to 3 instances in us-west ingesting 0.5% of traffic (canary sampling). Monitor: log-ingest-latency, json-parse-errors, `s3_put_errors`, and Grafana panels `SLO:ingest_success_rate` and `Per-tenant log size`. If any spike > 3x baseline open paged incident.
infra-bot: deploy-canary started by jen on us-west at 2026-03-18T15:23:00Z (run id c-7892).
matt: Quick query for dashboards — example Loki filter: `{app="log-forwarder"} | json | gpu_group=~"a100.*" | count_over_time(5m)`. For metrics exporter PromQL: `sum by(gpu_group) (rate(log_forwarder_errors_total[5m]))`.
linh: Also update the pipeline schema doc (`/docs/log-schema.md`) with new fields: `gpu_group`, `gpu_id_hash`, `redaction_version`. Add migration note: old messages without `gpu_group` should be backfilled from instance metadata for 30 days.
sasha: Backfill plan: run a 48h job that reads raw logs, enriches with instance SKU mapping, writes to `backfill/v1/` prefix in S3. We'll keep original messages but mark `backfilled:true`.
omar: Cost tradeoff: adding `gpu_group` increases ingestion by ~1-2 bytes per log but backfill + reprocessing could be ~1.2 TB of extra reads. We should budget ~ $1.5k for backfill egress and S3 PUTs. Approve?
jen: Approve for canary scope. For full backfill we need finance OK. I'll create a ticket.
sasha: Action items: 1) commit parser PR that redacts email patterns and emits `gpu_group` (sasha). 2) add canary sampling override for us-west (jen). 3) update alerts to group by `gpu_group` (matt/omar). 4) docs + schema bump (linh). 5) cost estimate and finance ticket (jen).
matt: I'll draft alert PR tonight.
linh: I'll draft the docs and a sample mapping table for instance->gpu_group.
jen: Starting canary in ~5m, tagging infra channel with updates. :thumbsup:
